note: Known defects for scripts/check-packaged-artifacts.mjs. An entry here downgrades a finding to KNOWN-DEFECT: it is printed loudly and counted, but does not fail the run. A known defect is NEVER counted as a pass. Delete the entry once the defect is actually fixed, so the gate can start enforcing it.

defects.summary: AGENTS.md's pre-release checklist names resources/agent-bundle/BashTool/BashWorker.js, but no build step emits it, so a packaged app cannot spawn the bash worker.
defects.status: open on master 5dc45fcf; found by E4.4-B, not introduced by it
evidence: packages/agent/src/tool/WorkerPool.ts:52 tries path.join(dirname, 'BashTool', 'BashWorker.js') first, i.e. inside the bundle directory.
scripts/build-agent-bundle.mjs writes only agent-process-entry.js, the CommonJS marker package.json, and the prompts assets/ tree. It never writes BashTool/.
scripts/after-pack.js verifies the agent entry, better_sqlite3.node and playwright, and FATALs when any is missing. It does not check BashWorker.js.
scripts/verify-packaged-parity.mjs does not list BashWorker.js either.

electron-builder.yml extraResources ships packages/agent/bundle/ and packages/agent/skills/ only; there is no resources/agent/tool/ tree, so the four fallback candidates in resolveBashWorkerPath() cannot resolve either.
Net effect: resolveBashWorkerPath() logs a warning and returns a path that does not exist, and WorkerPool then fails to spawn the child.
defects.proposedFix: Emit the worker next to the bundle. BashWorker.ts is a separate process entry that cannot be inlined by the agent-bundle build, so build-agent-bundle.mjs should esbuild it to packages/agent/bundle/BashTool/BashWorker.js (its own entry point, CJS, its own externals), after-pack.js should verify it, and this baseline entry should be deleted.
defects.removalCriterion: packages/agent/bundle/BashTool/BashWorker.js is emitted by a build step, after-pack.js FATALs when it is missing, and this entry is deleted from the baseline.
